lessons: Keep the HELD boundary, drain exclusion, restart projection, confirm CLI publish path, and single admission entry. Review found only two fixable defects; fix just those.

Key the admission regate by candidate base on every path: always pass effect_identity=state.slip.base to merge._regate, whatever the verb. Never let effect_identity depend on supervised or verb; that dual path made offline `squatch confirm` replay the stale regate.

Add a test that builds the confirm release through the same compose_pipeline arguments `_locked` uses for verb=confirm (supervised=False). Move main, confirm, and assert the regate ran again against the new base instead of replaying the stored effect.

In runner._finish_delivery, route with the effective rung: tier, effort = effective(ticket, rungs(journal.read(), ticket.stem)); Rung(tier, effort). Do not use ticket.agent_tier/agent_effort. Refactoring must not change escalation routing.
Add or keep a test that routes a failure after an escalation and asserts `route` receives the escalated rung, so the extracted terminal handler cannot regress it.
reason: Review snagged two concrete defects that can be fixed in place: an offline confirm regate cache key collision and base-rung routing in the extracted terminal handler. Checks passed and the rest of the design was accepted.
